projects.heading: Chapter 4 Projects
projects.paragraph: Chapter 4 projects are available online at bit.ly/30IM8gT.

list.item: Exploring Subspaces: This project explores subspaces with a more hands-on approach.
Hill Substitution Ciphers: This project shows how to use matrices to encode and decode messages.

Error Detecting and Error Correcting: In this project, a method detecting and correcting errors made in the transmission of encoded messages is constructed. It will turn out that abstract vector spaces and the concepts of null space, rank, and dimension are needed for this construction.
Signal Processing: This project examines signal processing in more detail.
Fibonacci Sequences: The purpose of this project is to investigate further the Fibonacci sequence, which arises in number theory, applied mathematics, and biology.
